description: Parameter NAMES are validated against the account's own vocabulary: an unknown session name refuses invalid parameter '<NAME>' for SET and UNSET alike (unquoted names upper-fold, quoted names keep their quotes), while an unknown key in an object's generic SET refuses invalid property '<NAME>' for '<KIND>'. Known names stay accepted whether or not the engine acts on them, because the registry is the account's list rather than the engine's implemented subset. Converted 1:1 from features/ParameterNameValidationTest (now retired).
